documentation.text:
@dev Internal function to remove a certificate ID from the proposedCertificateIds list after it has been approved.
 @param _certificateId The ID of the certificate to remove.

approveCertificate(bytes32).details: Approves (issues) a proposed certificate by the university. Only the owner (University) or an Admin can approve certificates.

params._certificateId: The ID of the proposed certificate to approve.

params._academicManagerContractAddress: The address of the StudentAcademicManager contract.
params._identityContractAddress: The address of the Identity contract.

getProposedCertificateIds().details: Retrieves a list of proposed certificate IDs awaiting university review. This function is intended for the university (Admin/Owner) to review certificates.

returns._0: An array of bytes32 containing IDs of proposed certificates.

proposeCertificate(address,string,string.details: Proposes a graduation certificate for a student automatically by the StudentAcademicManager system. This function can only be called by the authorized StudentAcademicManager contract.

params._collegeName: The name of the college within the institution.
params._institutionName: The name of the issuing institution/university.
params._isCustomDesign: A flag indicating if the certificate has a custom design.
params._programName: The name of the academic program/major.

returns._0: certificateId The ID of the proposed certificate.

revokeCertificate(bytes32).details: Revokes an issued certificate. Only the original issuer of the certificate (University/Admin) can revoke it.

params._certificateId: The ID of the certificate to revoke.

verifyCertificate(bytes32).details: Verifies the details of a specific certificate. This function can be called by anyone to verify a certificate.

params._certificateId: The ID of the certificate to verify.

returns.institutionName: The name of the issuing institution.
returns.isCustomDesign: True if the certificate has a custom design.
returns.issuedAt: The timestamp when the certificate was proposed/issued.
returns.issuer: The address of the institution that issued the certificate.
returns.programName: The name of the academic program.
returns.state: The current state of the certificate (PROPOSED, ISSUED, REVOKED).
returns.student: The address of the student who owns the certificate.
